classification: Warm-restart diagnostic. It executes the original physical path to the predeclared .4938 s trigger, then performs only the already-declared frozen-water mechanical map; not a production result or continuation.

mechanical_map.censoring: On a phase-T bound violation, write trigger, sweep-1 and offending phase/common temperature arrays before fatal exit; do not continue. At the first pre-clamp absolute pressure below unchanged pMin, log raw state, skip stock clamp and exit censored.
held: phase thermo T checked against the strict 128-epsilon per-element rule
SST transported k and omega, nut and alphat fields
Time index, physical time, deltaT, and materialized oldTime fields
no_updates: No alpha equation or MULES update
No TEqn solve or common temperature change
No runTime increment, physical checkpoint or continuation
mechanical_map.outer_state: Reuse the active PIMPLE controller at corr=8; finalIter remains true for all eight diagnostic sweeps. Each sweep uses the normal two-corrector loop and corrector-2 finalSolver selection.
mechanical_map.trigger: Complete original final outer-8, pressure-corrector-2 update at the first physical time >= 0.4938 s.
updated_by_source_order: alphaPhi2 and rhoPhi from current fields
mixture continuity error and UEqn A/H after current rho/rhoPhi
mixture.correctThermo() and mixture.correct() at the original post-TEqn position with common T held
two transonic pressure correctors, p_rgh/p/EOS rho/psi, phi/U/K and raw dgdt/Gamma

other_held_state: All existing non-phase-T held hashes and Euler old-time histories remain exact. Physical source order is unchanged: alpha/flux, turbulence.correctPhasePhi, UEqn, fixed-T thermo refresh at the original post-TEqn position, then two pEqn correctors.

diagnostic_metrics: internal global max absolute delta K
phase_temperature_invariant.if_out_of_bound: write trigger, sweep-1, and offending phase-T/common-T arrays to rank-local binary snapshots; abort before held-field integrity check and before pressure sweep continuation
phase_temperature_invariant.if_within_bound: log phase-T hashes and numeric deltas, then continue all eight declared mechanical sweeps; do not require phase-T hashes to remain byte-identical
phase_temperature_invariant.per_element_rule: abs(Tphase_current - Tphase_trigger) <= 128 * numeric_limits<scalar>::epsilon() * max(1, abs(Tphase_trigger)) for every internal cell and boundary value
phase_temperature_invariant.reference: each phase temperature at physical map trigger, after the original physical outer-8/corrector-2/EOS/U/K completion and before any mechanical-map operation

physical_case.mesh: Corrected native I4F apparatus, 299214 cells, ten-rank decomposition.
physical_case.physical_change_before_trigger: None intended. Trigger is after original final outer-8/corrector-2 pressure, EOS density, flux, velocity and K updates. Physical fvSolution is byte-identical to source template.
physical_case.solver: Isolated DCEC compressibleInterFoam v2512-derived source and executable.
physical_case.time_controls: Unchanged from original healthy warm parent: adaptive Euler time stepping, maxDeltaT=2.5e-4 s, original maxCo/maxAlphaCo and write controls.

qualification: The .460 startup thermo roundtrip showed idempotent thermo refresh after createFields/thermo construction but did not resolve the .493 held-phase hash mismatch. This run measures the trigger-state phase-T rederivation directly. The 128-epsilon rule is a strict floating-arithmetic invariant, not a physical convergence tolerance or a field reset.

snapshot_contract.layout: rank-local binary64 internal field followed by boundary patches in patch order; header contains magic, local internal count, patch count and each patch size

trigger.physical_state: after original outer 8 / pressure corrector 2, EOS/U/K updates complete
